overall_notes: This paper focuses on vision-language pre-training with explicit position modeling. While it involves generation tasks (position tokens and text tokens), it's primarily a vision-language modeling paper rather than a pure NLG evaluation paper. The generation tasks are specialized to the vision-language domain (object positions, visual relations, visual QA). Automatic metrics are used but no human or LLM evaluation is conducted.
